title: BC facility layer (FFCM / ISED Mills DB 2015 proxies)
publisher: UBC FRESH, derived from ISED Mills DB 2015 and FFCM
licence: Project-derived BC chain layer; upstream ISED Mills DB 2015 / FFCM proxies. Upstream source is not relicensed here.
access_method: Existing derived CSV in the project data repository: data/derived/national/bc_chain/facilities_bc.csv
notes: Capacities are normalised processing-line infeed proxies from the 2015 Mills DB/FFCM lineage, not licensed or current capacity. 81 source records have no coordinate and are retained explicitly.

title: OpenStreetMap facility features via Overpass API
notes: Tags used: craft=sawmill, industrial=sawmill and related values, man_made=works with wood/product or mill-name tags, power=plant or generator with biomass/wood source, and named industrial landuse. OSM features are mapped presence, not verified operating status.

title: Canada ADM1 boundaries (validation only)
notes: Used only to validate coordinates and assign OSM features to provinces/territories; no facility attributes are taken from it.
